confirmDeleteMeal: Delete this logged meal? It will be removed from daily totals.
exportDescription: Download your account, foods, recipes, meal logs, and correction history as JSON.
deleteAccountDescription: Permanently remove this account and its private data. Download your data first if you want to keep it.

title: Hustle Daily
signInHeadline: Your day, in one calm view.
signInDescription: Food, energy, movement and sleep, together. Track your meals here; more daily insights are on the way.
signInPrivacy: Private account. Hustle Daily doesn’t give medical advice.
signInSubheading: Use the account set up for you.
signInHelp: There’s no public sign-up. For access or password help, contact your account administrator.
targetsEffectiveNote: Choose a day type for each day. Edits apply from today; past days keep their earlier targets.
customDayTypesLater: Custom day types are not available yet
budgetHint: Shown as kcal left or over budget. Going over is not celebrated.
proteinHint: Shown as grams to go, then minimum met. Going over is fine.
setStepsTarget: Set a steps target for this day type
noStepsTargetHint: No steps target. Steps still appear on Today as an illustrative preview until Health sync exists.
workoutSuggestionPreview: Preview: a workout of 20 minutes or more could suggest Training Day. Your selection would not change automatically.
defaultDayTypePreview: Preview: Rest Day is currently the default for a new day. Changing this setting is not available yet.
invalidTargets: Enter positive targets within the allowed ranges.
targetsSaved: Saved. These targets apply from today.
dayTypeSaveError: Day type could not be saved. Try again.
reviewNotAvailable: Daily review is not available yet
previewNoticeBody: Amber dashed cards contain sample values, not your health data. Food totals and logged meals remain live.
healthSampleExplanation: Illustrative Apple Health values; no Health data has synced to this account.
sampleStepsNote: Illustrative steps, not a real device reading.
workoutNotDoubleCounted: Workout energy is part of Active energy, not added to Total burned twice. Sample only.
browserCannotReadHealth: This browser cannot read Apple Health. Health sync is not implemented yet.
sampleNoteText: Example note — today’s notes are not saved yet.
notesNotSaved: Preview only · editing and saving notes are not available yet.
healthLaterDescription: Apple Health energy, activity, sleep and body data will appear here in a later phase.
foodOnlyForNow: Food totals above come only from meals logged in Hustle Daily.
mealEditHint: Edit or delete a logged meal below.
noFoodsHelp: Try another name or brand, or create the food yourself.
name: Name
unavailable: Cannot load data. Check your connection and retry.
recent: Use an existing ready meal or choose ingredients one by one.
missingMeal: This meal is not in the selected day's list.
historyFutureNotice: Health and concluded-day status are coming later
historySummaryDescription: Daily food totals and the targets that applied on that date. Health data and daily conclusions are coming later.
correctDayTypeHint: Use this only to correct a day that was assigned the wrong type. Its historical targets will update.
historyHealthUnavailable: Burned energy, balance, activity and sleep are unavailable until Apple Health sync is implemented.
foodHistoryOnly: Food history only; HealthKit and day summaries come in later phases.
